blockingIssues.problem: The rationale asserts that the added hierarchy rule "caused the shift toward orchestration across the candidate runs." The source documents that the candidate prompt change coincided with a consistent shift (the candidate runs made orchestration central) but does not establish a definitive causal link attributing the shift solely to that prompt change.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Source records that the only prompt change was adding the generic "Preserve Editorial Intent from the Synthesis" section and then reports candidate runs where "orchestration/orchestration-first positioning" became central and the candidate "was not sufficient to protect the supplied editorial intent." It also notes possible internal tension in the baseline Synthesis that "may have reinforced the technical angle." The report stops short of claiming a proved causal mechanism.
blockingIssues.constraint: The source permits describing an observed association or the experiment team's interpretation, but does not support presenting the prompt addition as a demonstrated cause. The rationale must preserve this uncertainty and attribution to the experiment's observation rather than asserting a proven causal effect.
